important_news_archive.headline: NVIDIA Expands AI Infrastructure Capacity in Partnership With Australia’s Data Center Ecosystem

important_news_archive.impact_chain: Direct: AI Models/Applications, Compute, Data Centers, Power/Electrical, Cooling. Second-order: Grid/Energy/Materials.

evidence_sources.title: NVIDIA Expands AI Infrastructure Capacity in Partnership With Australia’s Data Center Ecosystem

facts: NVIDIA today announced that it is collaborating with a growing ecosystem of Australian NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs) and AI infrastructure partners to expand land, power and shell capacity designed to host multiple generations of NVIDIA DSX™ AI factories, supporting the nation’s growing demand for AI compute — with up to a 2-gigawatt buildout by 2027.

“CDC operates more than 550 megawatts of capacity across Australia and New Zealand, with a further 800 megawatts under construction and additional growth planned to support world-leading, high-density workloads for critical infrastructure,” said Greg Boorer, founder and CEO of CDC.

“Our facilities use 100% renewable electricity and incorporate pioneering zero water advanced cooling technologies certified for NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure.” NEXTDC has developed AI-ready data center infrastructure designed to support high-density AI factories, providing the power, cooling, connectivity and physical infrastructure required to deploy increasingly compute-intensive AI systems.

Building on already-rapid customer adoption of NVIDIA-accelerated compute on AWS, the companies plan to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS’s global infrastructure and deepen their work together across AI factories, CPUs, networking, open models, data processing and robotics, delivering co-engineered AI solutions that enable customers to accelerate AI development and deployment at unprecedented scale.

methodology.source_policy: Official company feeds are ingested directly and clustered with configured reliable financial and industry coverage. Unsupported publishers do not qualify.
methodology.archive_policy: Prior selected stories move to the archive when they leave the current top-news set; records are deduplicated by normalized headline and source.
methodology.scoring_note: Importance uses source quality, quantified materiality, direct industry reach, primary confirmation, company specificity, corroboration and recency. News does not calculate Radar scores or rank investment opportunities.
methodology.selection_policy: At most five stories are shown. No quota is filled; only stories scoring at least 70 qualify.

growth_diagnostics.initial_screen: Operating U.S.-listed common stock; price >= $3; market cap >= $300M; daily volume >= 100K; dollar-volume proxy >= $2M; sector and industry present.
growth_diagnostics.technical_scan_sampling: Up to 360 liquid names are sampled round-robin by sector. A 25% lane is reserved for otherwise-qualified companies at or below $5B market cap, and the remaining lane uses the full eligible universe; each lane is ordered by dollar-volume proxy. Only price/volume history is requested at this stage.
growth_diagnostics.technical_pattern_screen: Requires current price history, no Falling/Failed Reversal/Unavailable/Extended gate, a mature 42/63-session base or confirmed rising short-term trend, and a >=45/100 pattern score across base, contraction, higher-low, primary trend/MA structure, pivot proximity, and S&P 500 relative strength. Fundamentals are not read until after this selection.
growth_diagnostics.ranking_policy: Dynamic Final Score ranks overall opportunity, strategy-specific pattern confirmation, and entry economics. Action is an independent gate and is not hard-sorted ahead of Discovery; Discovery candidates are never promoted into Action by rank alone.
growth_diagnostics.no_action_policy: If Action Pool count is zero, the UI states that no current entry passed rather than manufacturing a BUY candidate.
growth_diagnostics.action_entry_gate: Action requires Discovery quality, Opportunity >=65, Fundamental >=60, a confirmed Growth entry path (Breakout, Reversal, or Pullback-Reacceleration), S&P 500 relative strength >=60, entry risk <=12%, reward/risk >=1.5x, and Growth or Catalyst >=65; support touch alone, Falling, Failed Reversal, Extended, first-bounce, and one-day moves remain WATCH.

methodology.base: A 63-session close range <=25%, or 42-session close range <=20%; this is a price-range screen, not a discretionary chart-pattern claim.
methodology.resistance: Highest close in the 60 sessions ending five sessions before the current close.
methodology.invalidation: Closest available support below price from the detected base low and MA50; omitted when neither is below price.
methodology.decline_and_bottom: Major-decline context uses the current close versus the trailing 252-session high; distance from the bottom uses the trailing 63-session low.
methodology.volume: Last-10-session average versus the preceding 20 sessions; accumulation compares up-day and down-day volume over 20 sessions.
methodology.higher_low: The trailing 20-session closing low must be at least 0.5% above the preceding 20-session closing low.
methodology.ma_slopes: MA20 compares with the equivalent 20-session average ending 10 sessions ago; MA50 compares with the equivalent average ending 20 sessions ago.
methodology.failed_breakout: A close more than 2% below prior resistance after any of the last five closes exceeded that resistance.
methodology.range_transitions: Counts alternating visits between the lower and upper quartiles of the trailing 63-session close range (42 sessions when 63 are unavailable).

methodology.scope: Secondary alert surface for previously identified public AI beneficiaries.
methodology.selection_boundary: Alerts do not alter, promote into, or rescore the main Early Discovery ranking.
methodology.ranking: Re-Acceleration Score ranks this secondary surface only: Technical Re-Acceleration 40%, Fundamental/Catalyst Support 25%, Entry Quality 20%, and Price Discovery 15%, followed by explicit risk penalties.
methodology.news_trigger: Ticker-identity-matched confirming evidence aged 0–7 days, Importance Score of at least 80, a credible event type, and a source link.
methodology.price_volume_trigger: Daily gain of at least 4% with volume at least 1.5 times the 20-day average.
methodology.commercial_trigger: Fresh company-linked evidence referencing earnings, orders, backlog, revenue, bookings, or guidance.
methodology.technical_trigger: Reversal requires a bullish MACD crossover; Breakout requires at least 1.2 times breakout volume. Bottoming alone never qualifies.
methodology.relative_strength_trigger: Positive 1M relative performance versus QQQ that is better than the available 3M relative result.
methodology.constructive_price_volume_trigger: Price above MA20 with a positive 1M return plus accumulation-like or elevated volume.
methodology.action_policy: Entry Stage may suggest an action only when a valid company-specific catalyst exists. Theme-only/unverified evidence is limited to WATCH / WAIT FOR VALID CATALYST.
methodology.missing_data: Missing or stale market inputs do not trigger a market-based alert.

methodology.strategy_logic: Rank science and clinical differentiation, trial/regulatory status, company-specific catalyst, probability-adjusted opportunity, commercial potential, competition, cash/dilution evidence, priced-in risk, and a trend/relative-strength/volume/entry overlay. Rank measures relative opportunity; Action independently requires the complete evidence and technical confirmation gates.
methodology.code_attribution: GeneDr Network implementation informed by common principles in the cited references; scoring, thresholds, classifications, and combined gates are original and are not the authors' formulas.
methodology.technical_setup_engine: Radar = Base / Breakout. Mature Base → contraction → higher low → confirmed reversal → resistance break on >=1.2x volume; only the confirmed Early Uptrend / Breakout stage is actionable.
methodology.dynamic_final_rank: Recalculated on every refresh from the existing probability-adjusted Biotech Radar rank score and the Radar-specific technical setup. Rank is independent of Action; catalyst, valuation, and entry inputs already represented by those domains are not added a second time.
methodology.high_conviction_boundary: Biotech Radar may include pre-revenue or binary development-stage companies. Radar status and score never qualify a company for long-term High Conviction.
methodology.horizon: Potentially valuation-changing catalysts expected within the next 183 days (approximately six months).
methodology.opportunity_score_policy: Opportunity Score is normalized over available weighted inputs. Missing inputs are excluded, never treated as zero, and Data Completeness must be reviewed with the score.
methodology.evidence_gate: Scientific Evidence below 18/30 cannot be High Conviction. High Conviction additionally requires Scientific Evidence of at least 24/30, 75% completeness, and High confidence.
methodology.integrity_gate: Explicit credibility or data-integrity concerns cap evidence confidence at Low.
methodology.news_boundary: Biotech News is retained as dated confirming, mixed, or contradicting evidence. News importance never sets a Radar factor or Opportunity Score.
methodology.market_data_policy: XBI price trend supplies up to 10 of 15 Sector Trend points; security trend/relative-strength inputs supply up to 5 of 10 Timing & Technicals points, while the separate setup records breakout volume and entry confirmation. Biotech Expectation Gap may use target headroom, price run-up, and positioning, but conventional P/E and EPS revisions are excluded. Options IV and advanced capital-flow data remain excluded.
methodology.binary_risk: Low / Moderate / High / Extreme uses available evidence uncertainty and catalyst magnitude; missing company valuation sensitivity or portfolio dependence prevents a Low classification.
methodology.early_discovery_ranking: Biotech Opportunity remains separate from Multibagger Potential. Final Radar ordering combines the two and subtracts an explicit 0–25 Already-Ran / Priced-In penalty.
methodology.entry_stage_boundary: The legacy compact stage remains for compatibility, while Radar action and Dynamic Final Rank use the separate Base / Breakout setup record.
methodology.scope_note: V1 scores the existing curated Company → Drug/Program → Indication → Catalyst set. Unavailable valuation, analyst, short-interest, trial, portfolio-dependence, options-IV and advanced capital-flow inputs remain missing.

ai_methodology.code_attribution: GeneDr Network implementation informed by common principles in the cited references; all scoring, thresholds, and classifications are original implementation choices, not the authors' exact formulas.
ai_methodology.technical_setup_engine: Radar = Base / Breakout. Action requires Mature Base → contraction → higher low → confirmed reversal → resistance break on >=1.2x volume; first bounce, volatile bottom, and pre-pivot reversal remain WATCH.
ai_methodology.dynamic_final_rank: The full existing AI/Technology universe is rescored every refresh. Rank is independent of Action and uses the already price-adjusted future opportunity score, Radar Base/Breakout setup, and explicit invalidation/risk; valuation headroom is not counted a second time. Action remains a separate gate.
ai_methodology.early_discovery_policy: A company may enter Radar from source-backed thesis evidence about technology, capability, capacity, customer exposure, supply-chain position, or competitive position. Orders, backlog, revenue, and earnings confirmation are not prerequisites.
ai_methodology.evidence_separation_policy: Shared theme evidence establishes demand or a value-chain constraint only. Ticker-specific evidence must directly name the company/ticker or a clearly linked company product, project, customer, contract, filing, financial result, partnership, regulatory event, or management statement.
ai_methodology.company_confirmation_policy: Revenue exposure, orders/backlog, earnings inflection, commercial confirmation, and company catalyst fields use ticker-specific evidence only. Missing proof remains Missing / Not Yet Confirmed; company filings, earnings material, and official sources receive selection priority.
ai_methodology.theme_only_score_policy: Theme-only beneficiaries remain discoverable, but company-confirmation confidence is labeled Low / Theme Only and company-dependent Opportunity, raw Multibagger, and ranking scores cannot exceed 74.
ai_methodology.high_conviction_boundary: Radar identifies potential future beneficiaries; its Trend Strength, Opportunity Score, and rank never qualify a company for long-term High Conviction.
ai_methodology.trend_strength_policy: Trend Strength uses available Structural, Demand, Bottleneck and Earnings factors. Missing factors are excluded, not scored as zero.
ai_methodology.opportunity_score_policy: Opportunity Score requires current Expectation Gap/Valuation and trend-specific Market Confirmation evidence. Missing inputs remain missing rather than becoming zero.
ai_methodology.expectation_gap_policy: Expectation Gap / Valuation aggregates evidence-supported public beneficiaries using Nasdaq valuation, analyst-consensus, estimate-revision and short-interest inputs plus the shared market layer's recent price run-up. At least two input groups are required.
ai_methodology.market_confirmation_policy: Market Confirmation aggregates price trend and relative strength versus QQQ across evidence-supported public beneficiaries; missing security data remains missing.
ai_methodology.physical_ai_policy: Demos and pilots cannot establish scaled or mass adoption. A3+ requires real commercial deployment evidence; A4+ requires quantified scale.
ai_methodology.early_opportunity_model: Each beneficiary receives separate Bottleneck Opportunity and Multibagger Potential scores. Candidate ranking follows emerging demand → constraint → supplier/moat → exposure → commercial inflection → valuation headroom → price-discovery status.
ai_methodology.dynamic_bottleneck_policy: A bottleneck score requires company/category-specific or event-language evidence of a constraint, scarcity, limited supply, capacity, or supply-chain role; category names alone do not create bottleneck points.
ai_methodology.priced_in_penalty: Final beneficiary ranking and Multibagger Potential subtract an explicit 0–25 penalty for Re-rating Underway / Already Ran and PARTIALLY / YES priced-in classifications.
ai_methodology.entry_stage_boundary: The legacy compact stage remains for compatibility, while Radar action and Dynamic Final Rank use the separate Base / Breakout setup record.

Anna Coulling — A Complete Guide to Volume Price Analysis

crypto_methodology.strategy_logic: Rank adoption/network strength, institutional demand, cycle/liquidity, regulatory and catalyst conditions, ecosystem importance, priced-in upside/risk, and a trend/momentum/BTC-relative-strength/volume/entry overlay. Rank is independent of Action; Action requires a complete current technical entry and defined invalidation.
crypto_methodology.code_attribution: GeneDr Network implementation informed by common principles in the cited references; scoring, thresholds, classifications, and combined gates are original and are not the authors' formulas.
crypto_methodology.scope: Focused crypto/stablecoin assets and public companies with material adoption exposure; this is not a broad token screener.
crypto_methodology.missing_data: Unavailable network activity, fees, valuation, token economics, or regulatory evidence remains missing and is excluded from normalized scores.
crypto_methodology.priced_in_penalty: The shared 0–25 Already-Ran / Priced-In penalty is subtracted from Multibagger Potential and final Radar ranking.
crypto_methodology.ranking: The existing 60% Crypto Opportunity + 40% raw Multibagger composite supplies the opportunity domain; Dynamic Final Score adds the distinct crypto technical overlay and applies the shared priced-in penalty once. Action remains an independent gate.
crypto_methodology.asset_type_boundary: Native crypto never uses equity P/E or EPS rules. Related public companies may use their existing company valuation and analyst evidence.
crypto_methodology.entry_stage_boundary: Falling / Bottoming / Reversal / Entry Zone / Breakout / Extended reuses the shared technical engine. Action additionally requires opportunity >=60, Multibagger >=50, >=60% evidence completeness, a confirmed entry, defined invalidation, and no Falling, Failed, Extended, or fully priced-in state.

methodology.relative_strength: Stock return minus benchmark return in percentage points for the same horizon.
methodology.entry_timing_inputs: Adds MA5/10, 42/63-session close ranges, MA compression, volume contraction/up-down volume, prior-60-session close resistance, and close-based support. Rules and source dates are retained in each record.
methodology.expectation_state: Requires at least two input groups. Underpriced, Fairly Priced, and Crowded / Priced In use transparent target-upside, forward-P/E, price-run-up, estimate-revision, and positioning signals; missing inputs remain null.
methodology.price_run_up: Uses existing 1M/3M/6M close-to-close returns as a recent pre-event proxy unless a verified event-specific anchor is available.
methodology.missing_data: Unavailable fields remain null; prior successful security records may be retained with data_status=stale.
methodology.security_display: Domicile comes from the listed-company source, never from the trading exchange. Foreign ADR, foreign U.S.-listed, and foreign OTC labels are display metadata only.

methodology.base: A 63-session close range <=25%, or 42-session close range <=20%; this is a price-range screen, not a discretionary chart-pattern claim.
methodology.resistance: Highest close in the 60 sessions ending five sessions before the current close.
methodology.invalidation: Closest available support below price from the detected base low and MA50; omitted when neither is below price.
methodology.decline_and_bottom: Major-decline context uses the current close versus the trailing 252-session high; distance from the bottom uses the trailing 63-session low.
methodology.volume: Last-10-session average versus the preceding 20 sessions; accumulation compares up-day and down-day volume over 20 sessions.
methodology.higher_low: The trailing 20-session closing low must be at least 0.5% above the preceding 20-session closing low.
methodology.ma_slopes: MA20 compares with the equivalent 20-session average ending 10 sessions ago; MA50 compares with the equivalent average ending 20 sessions ago.
methodology.failed_breakout: A close more than 2% below prior resistance after any of the last five closes exceeded that resistance.
methodology.range_transitions: Counts alternating visits between the lower and upper quartiles of the trailing 63-session close range (42 sessions when 63 are unavailable).

radar_unique_company_focus.policy: The full existing universe is rescored on every refresh; Dynamic Final Score determines rank independently of Action status. The Top 20 unique public companies each receive their strongest category-specific Radar placement.

diagnostics.primary_bottleneck_fixed: Company discovery previously required an explicit company mention in a current news event; active themes now scan and validate a general listed-company profile universe.
diagnostics.remaining_source_constraint: Discovery breadth depends on the industry/product metadata present in the listed-company source; missing profile detail remains missing.

policy.no_manual_ticker_insertion: Stock discovery scans source-backed company profiles in a general listed-company universe using category capability rules, not a theme-specific ticker list.
policy.size_diversity: Market capitalization is context only. It never raises relevance; diversity selection prevents equally credible results from being dominated by mega caps.
policy.discovery_not_scoring: Reasoning signals create research candidates only; existing Radar scoring remains unchanged.
policy.early_entry_policy: Orders, backlog, guidance, customers, and revenue are not required for Radar entry when source-backed thesis evidence establishes a logical beneficiary connection.
policy.evidence_separation: Thesis Evidence explains why a company may benefit; Confirmation Evidence records commercial proof without replacing the thesis.
policy.missing_data: Unresolved company identity remains unresolved and is not converted into a ticker.

methodology.scope: Focused output from broad public-company profile discovery and evidence-derived AI themes; this is not a generic stock screener.
methodology.ai_flow: Evidence → structured reasoning → theme discovery → beneficiary discovery → stock discovery → Radar.
methodology.no_manual_ticker_insertion: Reasoning-driven stocks come from evidence identities or category-validated profiles in a general listed-company universe, not manually added theme tickers.
methodology.candidate_is_not_conviction: Discovery is research coverage only and cannot pass any High-Conviction gate.
methodology.biotech_path: Therapeutic trend → program → company → catalyst when a current Radar record exists; related modality matches remain unverified discovery candidates.

methodology.missing_policy: Available weights renormalize; absent, stale or incomparable inputs are not zero.
methodology.source: Nasdaq annual reported financial statements; fiscal dates are not publication dates.
limitations: Monetary scale not declared: raw provider values retained; no absolute USD amounts inferred.
Annual financial ratios, not quarterly estimates or forecasts.
Cash runway is a historical burn proxy, not management guidance.
No verified segment earnings sensitivity, lead-asset dependence, or complete pipeline census is assumed.

revenue_growth.method: Annual year-over-year %; a missing/nonpositive base or nonannual interval is not scored.

earnings_growth.method: Annual year-over-year %; a missing/nonpositive base or nonannual interval is not scored.

eps_growth.method: Annual year-over-year %; a missing/nonpositive base or nonannual interval is not scored.

net_income.method: Latest annual reported net income in provider units; used only for a loss-making quality cap.

margin_trend.method: Annual change in operating margin, percentage points.

free_cash_flow.method: Annual operating cash flow minus absolute capital expenditures; provider monetary scale unspecified.

fcf_margin.method: Annual free cash flow / same-period revenue, %.

cash_and_investments.method: Cash plus short-term investments; missing investments are not zero.

observations.line_item: Short-Term Debt / Current Portion of Long-Term Debt

total_debt.method: Short-term plus long-term debt; missing debt is not zero.

observations.line_item: Short-Term Debt / Current Portion of Long-Term Debt

net_cash.method: Cash plus short-term investments minus total debt, same balance-sheet date.

cash_runway.method: Months of cash at the statement date using annual operating burn; proxy, not management guidance or today's runway. Positive operating cash flow is not infinite runway.

components.rationale: Annual year-over-year %; a missing/nonpositive base or nonannual interval is not scored.

methodology.strategy_logic: Rank moat, management/capital allocation, earnings and cash-flow quality, balance sheet, ROIC, growth runway, valuation/margin of safety, compounding potential, and downside risk. methodology.code_attribution: GeneDr Network implementation informed by common principles in the cited references; scoring, thresholds, classifications, and combined gates are original and are not the authors' formulas.
methodology.technical_setup_engine: High Conviction = Uptrend / Pullback / Continuation. Action requires Established Uptrend → Healthy Pullback → rising-MA50 Higher Low / Support Hold → momentum-backed prior-10-session-high reclaim.
methodology.dynamic_final_rank: Recalculated on every refresh from long-term quality evidence only. Technical setup, market confirmation, entry quality, catalyst timing and invalidation do not alter rank; they determine Action separately.
methodology.radar_separation: Radar is an early-discovery system and may include pre-revenue or unconfirmed beneficiaries. Radar rank never grants High-Conviction eligibility; evidence-linked Radar context is only a limited input within Growth Runway.
methodology.candidate_policy: Radar, broad shared-market confirmation screening, current/archived News catalysts, and established research candidates are merged; source alone never grants eligibility.
methodology.phase_6_integration: Reported growth, earnings/free-cash-flow quality, balance-sheet strength, competitive-position evidence, long-term runway, and valuation determine eligibility and ranking. Aggregate Company Quality is a gate, not a duplicate scored factor.
methodology.missing_data_policy: Missing factor scores are excluded and weights are renormalized; missing inputs never become zero.
methodology.high_conviction_rule: A total score of at least 80, at least 80% completeness, and every applicable long-term quality, valuation, and biotech-integrity gate are required for the strict High Conviction classification. Quality candidates that clear the core evidence gates but remain Watch / Setup Forming stay visible in rank with that classification; market confirmation and remaining upside apply to Action timing only.

methodology.base: A 63-session close range <=25%, or 42-session close range <=20%; this is a price-range screen, not a discretionary chart-pattern claim.
methodology.resistance: Highest close in the 60 sessions ending five sessions before the current close.
methodology.invalidation: Closest available support below price from the detected base low and MA50; omitted when neither is below price.
methodology.decline_and_bottom: Major-decline context uses the current close versus the trailing 252-session high; distance from the bottom uses the trailing 63-session low.
methodology.volume: Last-10-session average versus the preceding 20 sessions; accumulation compares up-day and down-day volume over 20 sessions.
methodology.higher_low: The trailing 20-session closing low must be at least 0.5% above the preceding 20-session closing low.
methodology.ma_slopes: MA20 compares with the equivalent 20-session average ending 10 sessions ago; MA50 compares with the equivalent average ending 20 sessions ago.
methodology.failed_breakout: A close more than 2% below prior resistance after any of the last five closes exceeded that resistance.
methodology.range_transitions: Counts alternating visits between the lower and upper quartiles of the trailing 63-session close range (42 sessions when 63 are unavailable).

methodology.missing_policy: Missing factors are excluded and available weights renormalize; missing inputs are never zero.

methodology.biotech_swing_plan: Biotech entry zones use a +/-1% band around the actionable current close or the existing calculated resistance planning reference. +10%/+15%/+20% levels are mechanical swing levels from that reference, not valuation targets.
methodology.price_basis: Daily provider close and volume history from the existing shared market layer; no adjusted-close or intraday series is claimed.

methodology.higher_low: The trailing 20-session closing low must be at least 0.5% above the preceding 20-session closing low.
methodology.ma_slopes: MA20 compares with the equivalent 20-session average ending 10 sessions ago; MA50 compares with the equivalent average ending 20 sessions ago.
methodology.failed_breakout: A close more than 2% below prior resistance after any of the last five closes exceeded that resistance.
methodology.range_transitions: Counts alternating visits between the lower and upper quartiles of the trailing 63-session close range (42 sessions when 63 are unavailable).

methodology.primary_screen: Pattern → Trend → Volume creates the ranked Candidate Pool before confirmation or execution gates.
methodology.strategy_a: Candidate: long base/decline + support stabilization + declining selling pressure. Preferred stages are Bottoming, Early Reversal, and Early Right-Side; BUY NOW requires multi-signal early reversal confirmation, not a major breakout. Catalyst is never required.
methodology.strategy_b: Candidate: >=8% gap + >=1.8x event volume. Then verify the company catalyst and evaluate Day 1 or subsequent hold/fade, consolidation, continuation pivot, entry, invalidation, and reward/risk.
methodology.catalyst_policy: Strategy A catalyst is optional. Strategy B requires a verified company-specific catalyst for BUY NOW, but unverified gap candidates remain ranked WAIT candidates.
methodology.buy_now_policy: No support touch, first bounce, candlestick, one-day move, unconfirmed pivot, failed setup, or Extended chart can enter BUY NOW.
methodology.execution_math: Stop=Limit Buy x 0.85; Full Exit=Limit Buy x 1.30; sell all at target with no runner.
methodology.missing_data_policy: Missing measurements fail the relevant gate and never create an entry price.

coverage.initial_screen: Every company in the Nasdaq-listed U.S. stock feed is evaluated: price >= $2, market cap >= $200M, daily volume >=150K, dollar-volume proxy >=$3M, and sector/industry present.
coverage.technical_history_funnel: Every eligible name receives daily OHLCV history. No Radar, Growth, or High-Conviction membership or score is read, and no arbitrary history-request quota truncates the screen.

take_home_messages: 2935 independently sourced full-market candidates had current price history.
37 top-ranked candidates are displayed across four independent pools; 1 are BUY NOW.
Strategy A catalyst is optional; Strategy B catalyst verification is a downstream BUY gate.
WAIT candidates remain visible with the exact missing confirmation; execution prices exist only for BUY NOW.

primary_references: Lawrence G. McMillan — Options as a Strategic Investment
Brian Overby — The Options Playbook
T. Ayers Pelz — The Biotech Trader Handbook, 2nd Edition
methodology.strategy_logic: Existing Directional Thesis → Horizon / Catalyst → IV / Expected Move → Liquidity / Spread → Defined Contract → Risk / Reward → Action.
methodology.independence: Options consumes existing strategy theses and never discovers, promotes, or re-ranks stocks in Radar, Growth, Biotech, Crypto, High Conviction, or Swing Trade.
methodology.missing_data_policy: Missing IV, expected move, liquidity/spread, expiry, strikes, premium, timing, or thesis confirmation produces WAIT / No recommendation; missing values never become positive evidence.
methodology.ownership_policy: Covered calls require at least 100 confirmed shares; protective puts require confirmed ownership. Browser-owned positions are not inferred by the server generator.
methodology.ranking_policy: Options Final Rank exists only when reliable option-market inputs support a risk-adjusted score. Unscored directional theses may remain visible as unranked WAIT assessments.
methodology.code_attribution: GeneDr Network implementation informed by common principles in the cited references; strategy routing, thresholds, scores, gates, and calculations are original and are not the authors' formulas.

reasoning: Options is a downstream risk-structure layer, not a stock-selection engine.
Defined-risk structures require verified IV, expected move, selected-leg liquidity, expiry, strikes, premium, breakeven, and reward/risk.
No contract is recommended from stock direction alone; missing chain data remains missing and forces WAIT.
take_home_messages: 75 existing public-equity directional theses were evaluated; no new ticker was discovered by Options.
0 have sufficient option-market data for Options Final Rank; 0 pass every Action gate.
Covered calls and protective puts require confirmed ownership; browser-only positions are never assumed.

assessments.rationale: Reliable IV and contract data are required before selecting an options structure.
assessments.catalyst: NVIDIA today announced that it is collaborating with a growing ecosystem of Australian NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs) and AI infrastructure partners to expand land, power and shell capacity designed to host multiple generations of NVIDIA DSX™ AI factories, supporting the nation’s growing demand for AI compute — with up to a 2-gigawatt buildout by 2027. “CDC operates more than 550 megawatts of capacity across Australia and New Zealand, with a further 800 megawatts under construction and additional growth planned to support world-leading, high-density workloads for critical infrastructure,” said Greg Boorer, founder and CEO of CDC.

methodology.base: A 63-session close range <=25%, or 42-session close range <=20%; this is a price-range screen, not a discretionary chart-pattern claim.
methodology.resistance: Highest close in the 60 sessions ending five sessions before the current close.
methodology.invalidation: Closest available support below price from the detected base low and MA50; omitted when neither is below price.
methodology.decline_and_bottom: Major-decline context uses the current close versus the trailing 252-session high; distance from the bottom uses the trailing 63-session low.
methodology.volume: Last-10-session average versus the preceding 20 sessions; accumulation compares up-day and down-day volume over 20 sessions.
methodology.higher_low: The trailing 20-session closing low must be at least 0.5% above the preceding 20-session closing low.
methodology.ma_slopes: MA20 compares with the equivalent 20-session average ending 10 sessions ago; MA50 compares with the equivalent average ending 20 sessions ago.
methodology.failed_breakout: A close more than 2% below prior resistance after any of the last five closes exceeded that resistance.
methodology.range_transitions: Counts alternating visits between the lower and upper quartiles of the trailing 63-session close range (42 sessions when 63 are unavailable).
